rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for checking or stating that information is correct.

example.english: I’ll confirm your information one more time.
example.traditional: 我再確認一次你嘅資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoi3 kok3 jing6 jat1 ci3 nei5 ge3 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this when specifically verifying facts, records, or a previous statement.

example.english: This office will confirm the information provided by the applicant.
example.traditional: 本處會核實申請人提供嘅資料。
example.jyutping: bun2 cyu3 wui5 hat6 sat6 san1 cing2 jan4 tai4 gung1 ge3 zi1 liu6

rows.note: Use this for an official authority approving a proposal, nomination, or appointment.

example.english: The government will confirm this appointment.
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 wui5 pai1 zeon2 ni1 hong6 jam6 ming6

rows.note: Use this when a committee, legislature, or other body passes a proposal or nomination.

example.english: The committee did confirm this nomination.
example.traditional: 委員會確實通過咗呢項提名。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui2 kok3 sat6 tung1 gwo3 zo2 ni1 hong6 tai4 ming4
